THE HEIR IN THE RAIN
EPISODE 5 - "THE BOARDROOM"

[00:00] MIRA RAO: And my first decision as chair... is about the Mehta Group.
[00:05] INT. RAO SHIPPING - BOARDROOM - DAY
[00:07] Glass walls, the harbour beyond. Mira sits at the head of the table. Desai at her side.
[00:12] Leela, Arjun and Tanya are led in by an assistant. Nobody offers them a seat.
[00:17] MIRA: Rao Shipping is withdrawing all investment from the Mehta Group. Effective today.
[00:23] ARJUN: You can't do that. Three hundred people work for us.
[00:27] MIRA: Two hundred and ninety-nine. I was fired, remember?
[00:31] LEELA: You ungrateful little-
[00:33] Leela raises her hand to slap Mira. Mira catches her wrist mid-air.
[00:37] MIRA: Not this time, Mrs. Mehta.
[00:40] She lets go. Leela stumbles back into a chair.
[00:44] Arjun drops to one knee beside Mira's chair.
[00:47] ARJUN: Mira, I made a mistake. Tanya means nothing. Please. Give me another chance.
[00:54] Mira places the pearl earring on the table in front of him.
[00:58] MIRA: You left this in your car. Give it back to its owner.
[01:03] Tanya stares at the earring, then at Arjun.
[01:06] TANYA: Means nothing? I'm carrying your child, Arjun.
[01:11] Arjun turns white. Leela gasps.
[01:14] MIRA: Then you two have a lot to talk about. Mr. Desai, show them out.
[01:20] INT. RAO SHIPPING - MIRA'S OFFICE - NIGHT
[01:22] Mira alone at her father's desk. She finally unties the bundle of letters.
[01:27] She reads the first one. Her eyes fill with tears.
[01:31] MIRA: (reading) "Asha, if anything happens to me, it was not an accident."
[01:37] Her phone lights up. Unknown number.
[01:40] MIRA: Hello?
[01:42] VOICE (V.O.): (distorted) Miss Rao. Your father didn't die of a heart attack.
[01:48] VOICE (V.O.): He was murdered. And his killer was at your gala last night.
[01:54] The line goes dead. Mira stares at her reflection in the dark window.
[01:59] CUT TO BLACK.
